summary.text: Jeff Klemp is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 5 (Leavenworth County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2025.
Jeff Klemp is listed as a vice chair of the Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Klemp is listed as a member of the Transportation Committee, the Assessment and Taxation Committee, the Commerce Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
The page names Joni Klemp as Jeff Klemp's spouse.
